summary:
Verified 3 user-facing changes on DynoPay preview. (B) SHORT 6-char base62 ref /pay?d=rNtQRX resolves and auto-progresses to awaiting checkout state (H1='Pay The Dev Store', amount='$15.00 USD', QR + LTC address 'LgMm9d8earcKZJjK...'). PASS. (C) The old 54px linear-gradient Swiss-grid backdrop is GONE from Pay3Layout — programmatic assertion Array.from(...).some(el => bg-image includes 'linear-gradient' && bg-size includes '54px') returned FALSE; no 54px background-size element found anywhere. Screenshot confirms clean background with only soft radial glows. PASS. (D) On /developer-keys the visible page shows ONLY the API key credential (two API key cards, each with a single readonly 'API key' input and its show/copy/regenerate/disable buttons). No 'Admin token' text is visible to the user in the initial render. HOWEVER, the DOM still contains a readonly and a visible Admin Token mounted inside a (currently hidden) MuiDialog — this is the SuccessAPIModel dialog that opens after generating a new API key. So while ApiKeysPage.tsx was cleaned as claimed, the admin-token row was NOT removed from Components/UI/ApiKeysModel/SuccessAPIModel/index.tsx (line 188: label={t('generate.adminToken')}). This means as soon as a merchant clicks Regenerate / creates a new key, the Admin Token field with show/copy buttons will re-appear in the success modal — contradicting task (D)'s stated intent that 'only the single API key remains'. No React ErrorBoundary triggered, no red console errors on /pay. On /developer-keys one non-blocking React devwarning (validateDOMNesting:
descendant of

) originating from ApiKeysPage.tsx line 205 PanelCard/Typography — cosmetic devwarning, no functional impact.

rca of the issue: The admin_token field is generated server-side and was historically exposed on both (a) the merchant API-keys listing page and (b) the post-generate success modal. The E1 patch removed it from (a) — Components/Page/API/ApiKeysPage.tsx — but did not touch (b) — Components/UI/ApiKeysModel/SuccessAPIModel/index.tsx:188 which still contains `label={t('generate.adminToken')}` with its show/copy adornments. Reproduction: log in as merchant → visit /developer-keys → inspect DOM: querySelector('input[aria-label="Admin Token"]') is non-null (inside the mounted-but-hidden MuiDialog). Live repro: click Regenerate on any API key → success dialog opens → Admin Token credential row is visible with show/copy buttons. Mitigation: delete the admin-token InputField block + related showAdminToken/adminToken/displayAdminToken state in SuccessAPIModel/index.tsx (same pattern as the ApiKeysPage fix).
